C1.name: FRC.Interactions.tetrahedral_group
C1.doc: 27:C1, 27:C4 — `SU(2, 𝔽₃)` over `𝔽₉`: `24 = q(q² − 1)` elements, closed under the product, non-abelian, every trace `a + ā` in the shell, the orders `1, 2, 3, 4, 6` in multiplicities `1, 1, 8, 6, 8` (the binary tetrahedral group), the traces `0, 1, 2` in multiplicities `6, 9, 9`; the drive `diag(i, −i) = (i, 0)` lies in the group and its centraliser has `4` elements.

C1.name: FRC.Unitary.class_function
C1.doc: 27:C1, 27:C4 — the trace is a class function: `Tr (g M g⁻¹) = Tr M` for `g` of determinant one, `g⁻¹` the adjugate; in general `Tr (g M adj g) = det g · Tr M`. The Wilson trace of a plaquette is gauge-invariant.

C2.name: FRC.Interactions.gauge_flux_invariant
C2.doc: 27:C2, 27:X1 — gauge invariance of the plaquette flux: with the corner gauges `φ₀, φ₁, φ₂, φ₃` and the links `A: 0 → 1`, `B: 1 → 2`, `C: 3 → 2`, `D: 0 → 3`, the transformed links `A + φ₁ − φ₀`, `B + φ₂ − φ₁`, `C + φ₂ − φ₃`, `D + φ₃ − φ₀` carry the flux `A + B − C − D` of the original.

C2.name: FRC.Interactions.projector_forced
C2.doc: 27:C2, 27:X3 — the photon's operator forced. A rotation-invariant quadratic symbol with constant part is `σ(k) = a k k + b |k|² δ + c δ`; gauge invariance, `σ(k) k = 0` for every `k`, reads `((a + b) |k|² + c) k = 0`, and its two evaluations at `|k|² = 1` and `|k|² = 2` give `a + b = 0` and `c = 0`: the symbol is `b (|k|² δ − k k)`, the transverse projector, massless (`c = 0`) and unique up to the one coefficient.

C2.name: FRC.Interactions.admissible_two
C2.doc: 27:C2, 27:X3 — the two admissible vectors satisfy every one of the `1 023` constraint rows (python's `13 338` rows distinct up to a scalar; that the range-1 translation-, gauge- and hypercubic-invariant quadratic actions at `L = 4` form exactly a two-dimensional space is the rank `121` of the rows, python's check A5), Maxwell's plaquette action satisfies them too, and it is their difference: `2 · Maxwell = B − A`.

C3.name: FRC.Interactions.green_torus
C3.doc: 27:C3 — the `L = 4` Coulomb Green's function in exact rationals: `7680 G` is the integer table, `ΔG = δ − 1/64` at every site (`7680 Δg = 7680 δ − 120`), `G(1, 0, 0) = 257/7680` (two unit charges at separation `1`), the table is cubic-symmetric on the axis and monotone `G(0) > G(1) > G(2)`, and its total is `0` (the zero mode removed).

C4.name: FRC.Interactions.drive_adjoint
C4.doc: 27:C4, 27:X1 — the drive on every shell. For the drive `δ = diag(g, h)` on a prime shell, with `g h = 1` and `g² ≠ 1`: `δ` fixes `H` and scales `E` and `F` by `g²` and `h²` (`adjoint_weights`); a matrix commutes with `δ` exactly when it is diagonal (`drive_commutes`); a matrix of determinant one commutes with `δ` exactly when it is `diag(a, d)` with `a d = 1`; each nonzero residue `a` gives one such matrix, `diag(a, a^(p−2))`, and `d` is decided by `a`; the nonzero residues are those of `1, …, p − 1` (`nonzero_residues`), so these matrices are the split cycle of order `p − 1`; and an element `[[a, ν b], [b, a]]` of the boost cycle with `b ≠ 0` does not commute with the drive.

C4.name: FRC.Interactions.va_cancel
C4.doc: 27:C4, 27:X6 — the cancellation of a boost over its cycle: on a prime shell, for `u^N = 1` and `u^{2δ} ≠ 1`, `Σ_{τ<N} u^{2δτ} = 0` (the turning branch) while `Σ_{τ<N} 1 = N` (the constant branch).

C4.name: FRC.Interactions.orientation_flip
C4.doc: 27:C4, 27:X6 — the orientation convention `ε ↦ −ε` relabels the branches: the inverse exponent `2(N − δ)` is as far from the identity as `2δ` (`u^{2δ} u^{2(N−δ)} = u^{2N} = 1`), so its branch sums to `0` too; the two conventions disagree on the label (`1 ≠ −1`), and `ε · ε > 0` for both signs.

C5.name: FRC.Chirality.mass_form
C5.doc: 27:C5, 27:X5 — the mass form of the doublet in the basis of the four generators. C5.name: FRC.Chirality.mass_block_square
C5.doc: 27:C5 — the neutral block `N = [[a², −a a′], [−a a′, a′²]]` has `N² = (a² + a′²) N`, entry by entry. Where `a² + a′² = 0` it squares to zero: the excluded case of the mass form.

C5.name: FRC.Chirality.invariant_form
C5.doc: 27:C5 — the invariant form `−2 tr(T²)` on the generators with `h = 1/2`: `4h² = 1` for the first, `−4 ν h² = −ν` for the three that carry `w`.

C5.name: FRC.Interactions.neutral_block
C5.doc: 27:C5, 27:X3, 27:X5 — the neutral mass block, cleared of `¼`: with `m₀₀ = g² v²`, `m₀₁ = −g g′ v²`, `m₁₁ = g′² v²`, `m₀₀ m₁₁ − m₀₁² = 0` (the massless photon); `(m₀₀, m₀₁) · (g′, g) = 0` and `(m₀₁, m₁₁) · (g′, g) = 0`; the block applied to `(g, −g′)` returns `(g² + g′²) v² · (g, −g′)`.

C5.name: FRC.Interactions.five_eighths
C5.doc: 27:C5 — `M_W²/M_Z² = cos²θ_W = 5/8`: `M_W² = g² v²/4` and `M_Z² = (g² + g′²) v²/4`, so the ratio is `g²/(g² + g′²)`; where `sin²θ_W = g′²/(g² + g′²) = 3/8`, that is `8 g′² = 3 (g² + g′²)`, the ratio reads `8 g² = 5 (g² + g′²)`, on every shell.

C6.name: FRC.Interactions.weinberg_angle
C6.doc: 27:C6, 27:X4 — the Weinberg angle from the charge spectrum of one generation: over the sixteen states of `gen16`, `Σ (6T₃)² = 72` and `Σ (6Q)² = 192`, so `Tr T₃² = 2`, `Tr Q² = 16/3` and `sin²θ_W = Tr T₃²/Tr Q² = 72/192 = 3/8` (`72 · 8 = 192 · 3`).

C7.name: FRC.Interactions.su3_centre
C7.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7, 35:C1, 35:X2 — the scalar centre of `SU(3, 2)` over `𝔽₄`: the scalars `x I` with `x x̄ = 1` and `x³ = 1` are the three cube roots of unity `1, w, w²` (`ℤ₃`, colour triality), `0` is not one, and each commutes with `U₁` and `U₂`; that the centre is no larger is 27-fields' ledger check E1 (all `216²` products) and, in the kernel, the hadrons theme's `FRC.Hadrons.colour_group` (the commutant of `D₁` and `U₁` in the group built by frames is the three scalars).

C7.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7 — the rank tower: for `Ω ≡ 5 (mod 12)` the cycle `Ω + 1 ≡ 6 (mod 12)` carries the ranks `1, 2, 3`, `2 ∣ Ω + 1` and `3 ∣ Ω + 1`, and stops there: `Ω + 1 ≡ 2 (mod 4)`, so `4 ∤ Ω + 1` and `gcd(4, Ω + 1) = 2`. The colour rank is `3`, the isospin rank `2`.

C11.doc: 27:C11 — `Ω ≡ 5 (mod 12)` is the conjunction `Ω ≡ 1 (mod 4)` and `Ω ≡ 2 (mod 3)`, for every natural number: the twelve residues decide it, and the three moduli are periodic in `12`.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.chirality_square
C13.doc: 27:C13 — the square of the product of four pairwise anticommuting elements is the product of their squares, with no sign left over.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.chirality_clifford
C13.doc: 27:C13 — with the Clifford relations of `diag(−c, 1, 1, 1)`, the product `Γ = γ⁰γ¹γ²γ³` has `Γ² ≈ −c`.

C13.doc: 27:C13 — for a central `u` with `u² ≈ −1` and `Γ² ≈ −c`, the element `uΓ` is a square root of `c`.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.neg_nonsquare
C13.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — on a shell with `i² = −1`, if `ν` is a nonsquare then `−ν` is a nonsquare: `x² + ν` has no root, so an element with square `−ν` has no eigenvalue on the shell.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.no_idempotent
C13.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — `𝔽_p[Γ]` holds no idempotent `a + bΓ` with `b` invertible: on a shell where `ν` is no square, `(a + bΓ)² = a + bΓ` and `b c = 1` are contradictory. An idempotent therefore has `b = 0` and is an idempotent of the shell.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.root_sq
C13.doc: 27:C13 — `(i w)² = −ν` in the extension: `i w` and `−i w` are the roots of `x² + ν`.

C13.name: FRC.Chirality.root_conj
C13.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — the Frobenius conjugation exchanges the two roots `i w` and `−i w`.

C14.doc: 27:C14 — the Frobenius conjugation fixes the shell's part of the extension.

C14.doc: 27:C13, 27:C14 — the Frobenius conjugation negates a multiple of `w`: it exchanges `i w` and `−i w`.

C14.name: FRC.Chirality.shell_mul_shell
C14.doc: 27:C14 — the grading is multiplicative: shell times shell is on the shell.

C14.doc: 27:C14 — a multiple of `w` times a shell element is a multiple of `w`.

C14.name: FRC.Chirality.shell_mul_root
C14.doc: 27:C14 — a shell element times a multiple of `w` is a multiple of `w`.

C14.name: FRC.Chirality.root_mul_root
C14.doc: 27:C14 — two multiples of `w` multiply to a shell element.

C14.doc: 27:C14 — an entry of the drive's lift times a shell element is negated by the Frobenius conjugation: on the coset of the lift, `σ(A) = −A` entry by entry.

C14.name: FRC.Chirality.drive_lift_square

C14.name: FRC.Chirality.tally_sign
C14.doc: 27:C14 — the sign cancels in a sesquilinear tally: `σ(−x)(−y) = σ(x) y`.

C15.name: FRC.Unitary.torus_cycles

C15.name: FRC.Unitary.cycle_orders
C15.doc: 27:C15 — the orders of the two cycles of the diagonal torus, on a prime shell with `ν` a nonsquare and `2 ≠ 0`. The unitary cycle: its points are `−1` and the Cayley points of the `p` residues, pairwise distinct, each has `w^(p+1) = 1`, no `0 < d < p + 1` is a period of all of them, and one of them has order `p + 1`.

X3.name: FRC.Interactions.neutral_block
X3.doc: 27:C5, 27:X3, 27:X5 — the neutral mass block, cleared of `¼`: with `m₀₀ = g² v²`, `m₀₁ = −g g′ v²`, `m₁₁ = g′² v²`, `m₀₀ m₁₁ − m₀₁² = 0` (the massless photon); `(m₀₀, m₀₁) · (g′, g) = 0` and `(m₀₁, m₁₁) · (g′, g) = 0`; the block applied to `(g, −g′)` returns `(g² + g′²) v² · (g, −g′)`.

X3.name: FRC.Interactions.projector_forced
X3.doc: 27:C2, 27:X3 — the photon's operator forced. A rotation-invariant quadratic symbol with constant part is `σ(k) = a k k + b |k|² δ + c δ`; gauge invariance, `σ(k) k = 0` for every `k`, reads `((a + b) |k|² + c) k = 0`, and its two evaluations at `|k|² = 1` and `|k|² = 2` give `a + b = 0` and `c = 0`: the symbol is `b (|k|² δ − k k)`, the transverse projector, massless (`c = 0`) and unique up to the one coefficient.

X3.name: FRC.Interactions.admissible_two
X3.doc: 27:C2, 27:X3 — the two admissible vectors satisfy every one of the `1 023` constraint rows (python's `13 338` rows distinct up to a scalar; that the range-1 translation-, gauge- and hypercubic-invariant quadratic actions at `L = 4` form exactly a two-dimensional space is the rank `121` of the rows, python's check A5), Maxwell's plaquette action satisfies them too, and it is their difference: `2 · Maxwell = B − A`.

X4.name: FRC.Interactions.weinberg_angle
X4.doc: 27:C6, 27:X4 — the Weinberg angle from the charge spectrum of one generation: over the sixteen states of `gen16`, `Σ (6T₃)² = 72` and `Σ (6Q)² = 192`, so `Tr T₃² = 2`, `Tr Q² = 16/3` and `sin²θ_W = Tr T₃²/Tr Q² = 72/192 = 3/8` (`72 · 8 = 192 · 3`).

X5.name: FRC.Chirality.mass_form
X5.doc: 27:C5, 27:X5 — the mass form of the doublet in the basis of the four generators. With `w² = ν`, the unit vacuum `(0, 1)` and `a = g / 2`, `a′ = g′ / 2`, the generators send the vacuum to `(a, 0)`, `(a w, 0)`, `(0, −a w)` and `(0, a′ w)`. Their Frobenius-Hermitian pairings lie on the shell: `a²` and `−ν a²` for the charged pair, whose mixed pairing cancels; `−ν a²`, `−ν a′²` and the mixed sum `2 ν a a′` for the neutral pair.

X5.name: FRC.Chirality.mass_spectrum
X5.doc: 27:C5, 27:X5 — the spectrum of the mass form against the invariant form `diag(1, −ν, −ν, −ν)`: the second charged generator has the value `a²` of the first; `(a′, a)` is the kernel of the neutral block (the photon); and `(a, −a′)` has the value `a² + a′²`.

X5.name: FRC.Chirality.mass_independent
X5.doc: 27:C5, 27:X5 — the two neutral eigenvectors `(a′, a)` and `(a, −a′)` are independent when `a² + a′² ≠ 0`: a combination `x (a′, a) + y (a, −a′) = 0` has `(a² + a′²) x = 0` and `(a² + a′²) y = 0`.

X6.name: FRC.Chirality.neg_nonsquare
X6.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — on a shell with `i² = −1`, if `ν` is a nonsquare then `−ν` is a nonsquare: `x² + ν` has no root, so an element with square `−ν` has no eigenvalue on the shell.

X6.name: FRC.Chirality.no_idempotent
X6.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — `𝔽_p[Γ]` holds no idempotent `a + bΓ` with `b` invertible: on a shell where `ν` is no square, `(a + bΓ)² = a + bΓ` and `b c = 1` are contradictory. An idempotent therefore has `b = 0` and is an idempotent of the shell.

X6.name: FRC.Chirality.root_conj
X6.doc: 27:C13, 27:X6 — the Frobenius conjugation exchanges the two roots `i w` and `−i w`.

X6.name: FRC.Interactions.orientation_flip
X6.doc: 27:C4, 27:X6 — the orientation convention `ε ↦ −ε` relabels the branches: the inverse exponent `2(N − δ)` is as far from the identity as `2δ` (`u^{2δ} u^{2(N−δ)} = u^{2N} = 1`), so its branch sums to `0` too; the two conventions disagree on the label (`1 ≠ −1`), and `ε · ε > 0` for both signs.

X7.name: FRC.Interactions.su3_centre
X7.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7, 35:C1, 35:X2 — the scalar centre of `SU(3, 2)` over `𝔽₄`: the scalars `x I` with `x x̄ = 1` and `x³ = 1` are the three cube roots of unity `1, w, w²` (`ℤ₃`, colour triality), `0` is not one, and each commutes with `U₁` and `U₂`; that the centre is no larger is 27-fields' ledger check E1 (all `216²` products) and, in the kernel, the hadrons theme's `FRC.Hadrons.colour_group` (the commutant of `D₁` and `U₁` in the group built by frames is the three scalars).

X7.name: FRC.Interactions.gluon_commutator
X7.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7, 27:X1 — the gluon self-coupling over `𝔽₄`: the two elements `U₁ = [[0,0,1],[0,1,0],[1,0,0]]` and `U₂ = [[0,0,1],[0,w,0],[w²,0,0]]` of `SU(3, 2)` (`U†U = I`, `det U = 1`) do not commute, their commutator plaquette `U₁U₂U₁⁻¹U₂⁻¹ = diag(w², 1, w) ≠ I`, while the abelian control `D₁ = diag(1, w, w²)`, `D₂ = diag(w, 1, w²)` returns `I`.

X7.name: FRC.Interactions.rank_tower
X7.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7 — the rank tower: for `Ω ≡ 5 (mod 12)` the cycle `Ω + 1 ≡ 6 (mod 12)` carries the ranks `1, 2, 3`, `2 ∣ Ω + 1` and `3 ∣ Ω + 1`, and stops there: `Ω + 1 ≡ 2 (mod 4)`, so `4 ∤ Ω + 1` and `gcd(4, Ω + 1) = 2`. The colour rank is `3`, the isospin rank `2`.

X8.name: FRC.Interactions.offblock_automorphism
X8.doc: 27:C9, 27:X8, 00:Z5 — each colour–isospin transposition is an automorphism of the reflection algebra of five directions up to the sign of the basis element: for all `S, T < 32`, `e_{τS} e_{τT}` vanishes exactly when `e_S e_T` does, and otherwise is `± e_{τ(S∪T)}`; the relabelling is a bijection of the `32` subsets.

X9.name: FRC.Ladder.tower_reduces
X9.doc: 26:G2, 27:C10, 27:X9, 27:P1, 28:X3, 00:G15 — a tower exponent is read modulo `n`: `g^{(g^j)} = g^{(g^j) mod n}`; tetration is exponentiation of a reduced index, and the two cyclic structures host every iterate (the ladder of the four roles closes: the fifth step returns to counting, 27-fields' C10).

X10.name: FRC.Interactions.koide_parseval
X10.doc: 00:G16, 27:X10, 27:P8, 28:C1, 28:X1 — Parseval on the cube-root orbit `C₃`: for amplitudes `a₀, a₁, a₂` and `ω` with `ω² + ω + 1 = 0`, `3 Σ a_j² = â₀² + 2 â₁ â₂`, `â₀ = Σ a_j`, `â₁ = a₀ + a₁ω + a₂ω²`, `â₂ = a₀ + a₁ω² + a₂ω` — the Koide form `Q = Σ a_j² / (Σ a_j)² = 1/3 + (2/3)ρ²` with `ρ² = â₁â₂/â₀²`, exact on every shell carrying the root `ω`.

X10.name: FRC.Interactions.koide_extension
X10.doc: 00:G16, 27:X10, 27:P8, 28:C2, 28:X1, 28:P1, on every shell: with `h + h = 1` and `ν = −3`, `ω = −h + h w` has `ω² + ω + 1 = 0`; `â₂ = â̄₁`, so `â₁ â₂ = N(â₁)`; Parseval `3 Σ a_j² = â₀² + 2 N(â₁)`; and `Q = 2/3 ⟺ 2 N(â₁) = â₀²` (`ρ² = 1/2`).

X10.name: FRC.Interactions.koide_half
X10.doc: 00:G16, 27:X10, 27:P8, 28:X1 — the hypotheses of `koide_extension` hold on every frame `p = 4κ + 1`, the Carrier included: `h = 2κ + 1` has `h + h = 1`, and `ν = −3` has `ν + 3 = 0`.

X11.name: FRC.Unitary.wilson_orientation_even
X11.doc: 27:X11, 27:P9, 00:G7 — the Wilson plaquette term `tr U + conj (tr U)`, twice the real part of the trace, is unchanged when the plaquette's orientation is reversed, `U ↦ U⁻¹`: for `U ∈ SU(3)`, `U⁻¹ = U†` and `tr U† = conj (tr U)`. The term is orientation-even, so the Wilson action class (the realisation B2) carries no orientation-odd term, no topological term.

X11.name: FRC.Unitary.hermitian_det_real
X11.doc: 27:X11, 27:P9, 00:G7 — the determinant of a Hermitian `3 × 3` matrix over the extension is its own conjugate: `A† = A` gives `conj (det A) = det A`; its imaginary part is then `2`-torsion (`hermitian_det_shell`), so on every odd shell `det A` lies in the shell and `arg det A = 0`.

X11.name: FRC.Unitary.gram_det
X11.doc: 27:X11, 27:P9, 00:G7 — the square of a Hermitian matrix: `det (A A) = det A · det A`, with `det A` its own conjugate and its imaginary part `2`-torsion. Where `det A` lies in the shell, `det (A A)` is the square of a residue of the shell.

X11.name: FRC.Unitary.hermitian_det_shell
X11.doc: 27:X11, 27:P9, 00:G7 — the determinant of a Hermitian `3 × 3` matrix has `2`-torsion imaginary part: on every odd shell it lies in the shell.

X11.name: FRC.Interactions.ckm_free
X11.doc: 27:X11 — over `𝔽₁₇[√−3]` and `𝔽₅₃[√−3]`: the textured up and down mass matrices and the circulant are Hermitian (`M† = M` entrywise), their determinants are nonzero and lie in the shell with `det (M_u M_d)` (`arg det = 0`, the strong-CP angle vanishes), and `[M_u, M_d] ≠ 0` (no flavour symmetry forces the two to be simultaneously diagonal).
